description: This file defines API endpoints for authentication, including login and signup, using FastAPI. It handles user credential verification, JWT token creation, and user registration, interfacing with database models and security helpers.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: Schema for login request containing email and password.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Schema for JWT token response containing access_token and expiry.

methods.name: Token login(data: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials and returns a JWT token.

methods.name: UserOut signup(data: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new user in the database.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^def login(data: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> Token:$/

ctags.name: signup
ctags.pattern: /^def signup(data: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> UserOut:$/
